answer: A milestone bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, files a cipher claim, then clears three milestones, one per epoch, each proved by a fresh relic receipt. Missing a milestone burns the bond. The spiral bites: a funder's k-th identity pays 35+8(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,031,000 for a 40,000 pool, profit at its nadir. Rented milestones fail: each receipt bears one key. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps its bond.
